A '''Time Ripple''' (Japanese: '''時の波紋''' ''Ripple of Time'') is a {{wp|time portal}} featured in the {{pkmn|movie}} ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. It appears when the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{p|Celebi}} [[Time travel|travels through time]]. It is described as a temporary focal point that collects time energy.

Time Ripples are invisible rifts that allow for instantaneous travel between two places in time. They can be made visible to the [[human]] eye for a short time through the use of {{m|Foresight}}. A Time Ripple provides all the necessary energy for Celebi to be able to time travel. It lasts approximately one day and it disappears when touched by Celebi.

==History==
===''Pokémon the Series''===
====''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''====
Twenty years prior to the events of the [[M13|movie]], a young [[Grings Kodai|Kodai]] managed to decipher ancient texts and unlock the secrets left behind by prophets. He learned that Time Ripples contain the power to show people {{wp|Precognition|visions of the future}} and he became interested in obtaining that kind of power. After that he traveled to [[Crown City]], where {{OBP|Celebi|M13}} is known to appear, in hopes of finding the Time Ripple it uses to [[time travel]].

He was able to locate the Time Ripple with the help of his {{p|Shuppet}} and then he incapacitated Celebi to prevent it from using the Time Ripple to leave Crown City, as that would make the Time Ripple disappear. He proceeded to use a device to absorb the energy within the Time Ripple into his body, and as a result, he gained the ability to see into the future. In the process, however, the Time Ripple was destroyed and the resulting shockwave caused all trees and flowers in Crown City to wither and die. [[Rowena]] explained to {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}} that it happened because the flow of energy was reversed.

Using his new ability, Kodai founded a powerful corporation bearing his name, the Kodai Network Group, and quickly became a successful businessman. However, as time passed, his ability started to fade and his visions became vague. In the present time, he traveled to Crown City again to renew his future sight abilities. He knew that Celebi would return to the city and he intended on absorbing the energy of its Time Ripple as he had done in the past.

The Time Ripple became visible when Kodai grabbed Celebi.

When he found the Time Ripple near the [[Pokémon Baccer World Cup]] stadium, he did not know it was actually an illusion created by {{OBP|Zoroark|M13}} and proceeded to absorb its energy. He also confessed that he was the one responsible for withering all of Crown City's greenery twenty years ago and his confession was videotaped by [[Karl]]. After realizing that the Time Ripple was not real, he decided to take revenge on Zoroark. The {{pkmn|category|Illusion Fox Pokémon}} fought back and Kodai was cornered by [[Legendary beasts (M13)|the city's guardian protectors]]. He managed to run away to the stadium, but Zoroark tricked him with another illusion and he passed out.

After that, Celebi noticed Zoroark's weakened state and decided to enter the true Time Ripple and use its energy to heal Zoroark. Contrasting the purple-colored energy shown when Kodai drained the Time Ripple and its negative impact on Crown City's vegetation, the energy flowed naturally and remained pure green while being absorbed by Celebi, and the Time Ripple disappeared with no ill effect.

===={{aniseries|SM}}====
A {{p|Celebi}} traveled through a Time Ripple in the {{aniseries|SM}} episode ''[[SM125|A Timeless Encounter!]]''.
